sections.subtitle: Pozdrav slušateljima i molitva za oslobođenje: vezanje zlih sila u Isusovo ime
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj Vladimir Grebenar pozdravlja gledatelje i započinje molitvu za oslobođenje i zaštitu
sections.content:
Na početku 121. epizode emisije **Oraetlabora Međugorje**, naslovljene „Milosrđe Božje – Kako graditi Hram Božji?“, voditelj **Vladimir Grebenar** pozdravlja gledatelje i slušatelje medija Ora et Labora. Odmah najavljuje i središnju misao dana iz evanđelja: Isus je između svojih učenika izabrao dvanaestoricu, koje je prozvao apostolima. Nakon znaka križa, „U ime Oca i Sina i Duha Svetoga“, emisija ne počinje razgovorom. Prvi dio je dugi molitveni blok koji priprema za kasnije tumačenje Božje riječi.

Prva je molitva za oslobođenje i zaštitu. U njoj Grebenar, u ime Isusovo, „uzima vlast“ i veže **sve zle sile i snage**. Pritom nabraja gdje se one mogu nalaziti:

- u zraku,
- na zemlji,
- u vodi,
- u podzemlju,
- na onome svijetu,
- u prirodi,
- u vatri.

Molitva zatim slavi Boga kao Gospodina „nad svim svemirom“, kojemu se daje slava u ime njegova stvorenja. Molitelj veže sve demonske sile koje su došle protiv molitelja i njihovih obitelji. Sve ih stavlja pod zaštitu **Isusove dragocjene krvi**, prolivene na križu.

Slijede tri zaziva:

- **Djevici Mariji** upućuje se molba za zaštitu i zagovor kod Presvetog Srca Isusova za sve obitelji, uz sliku Marijina plašta ljubavi koji „zaogrće“ vjernike „da se prestraši neprijatelj“.
- **Svetom Mihovilu** i **anđelima čuvarima** upućuje se poziv da brane molitelje i njihove obitelji „u borbi protiv svega zla što obilazi svijetom“.
- Na kraju dolazi zapovijed u Isusovo ime: sve sile i snage zla neka „istog časa“ odstupe od molitelja, njihovih domova i njihove zemlje.

Molitva završava zahvalom Isusu „jer si vjeran Bog i osjećaš s nama“.
sections.subtitle_en: Greeting to listeners and prayer for deliverance: binding evil forces in Jesus' name
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host Vladimir Grebenar greets viewers and begins the prayer for deliverance and protection
sections.content_en:
At the beginning of the 121st episode of the show **Oraetlabora Međugorje**, titled „Divine Mercy – How to Build the Temple of God?“, host **Vladimir Grebenar** greets the viewers and listeners of the media Ora et Labora. He immediately announces the central thought of the day from the Gospel: Jesus chose twelve from among his disciples, whom he named apostles. After the sign of the cross, „In the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit“, the show does not begin with a conversation. The first part is a long prayer block that prepares for the later interpretation of the Word of God.

The first is a prayer for deliverance and protection. In it, Grebenar, in the name of Jesus, „takes authority“ and binds **all evil powers and forces**. In doing so, he lists where they may be located:

- in the air,
- on the earth,
- in the water,
- in the underworld,
- in the other world,
- in nature,
- in fire.

The prayer then praises God as the Lord „over all the universe“, to whom glory is given in the name of his creation. The intercessor binds all demonic forces that have come against the intercessors and their families. He places them all under the protection of **Jesus' precious blood**, shed on the cross.

Three invocations follow:

- A petition is addressed to the **Virgin Mary** for protection and intercession before the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus for all families, along with the image of Mary's mantle of love that „cloaks“ believers „so that the enemy is frightened“.
- A call is addressed to **Saint Michael** and the **guardian angels** to defend the intercessors and their families „in the battle against all evil that roams the world“.
- At the end comes a command in Jesus' name: let all forces and powers of evil depart „at this very moment“ from the intercessors, their homes, and their land.

The prayer ends with thanks to Jesus „because you are a faithful God and feel with us“.

sections.subtitle: Sveti Mihael arkanđel i molitva za jedinstvo s Isusom
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli molitvu svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu i molitvu za jedinstvo s Isusom
sections.content:
Iza molitve za oslobođenje slijedi **molitva svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu**. Vladimir Grebenar u njoj zaziva arkanđela da brani vjernike „u boju protiv pakosti i zasjeda đavolskih“ i da im bude zaklon. Molitva naziva Mihaela „vojvodom vojske nebeske“ i moli ga da Sotonu i druge zle duhove, „koji svijetom obilaze na propast duša“, „božanskom krjepošću i jakošću u pakao strovali“.

Ton se potom mijenja. S borbenih slika molitva prelazi na nježnu **molitvu za jedinstvo s Isusom**. Molitelj se obraća „ljupkom Isusu“ i moli da se život vjernika potpuno uskladi s njegovim. Slike se nižu jedna za drugom:

- neka noge zajedno hode,
- neka ruke budu skupljene u jedinstvu,
- neka srca kucaju zajedno,
- neka duše budu u skladu, a misli „kao jedno“,
- neka uši zajedno „slušaju tišinu“,
- neka pogledi „duboko prodru jedan u drugi“.

Na kraju dolazi molba da usne zajedno mole kako bi se „zadobilo milosrđe od vječnoga Oca“. Time se prvi put izravno pojavljuje tema **milosrđa**, oko koje je izgrađen cijeli molitveni dio epizode.
sections.subtitle_en: Saint Michael the Archangel and prayer for unity with Jesus
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host prays the prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel and the prayer for unity with Jesus
sections.content_en:
After the prayer for deliverance follows the **prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel**. In it, Vladimir Grebenar invokes the archangel to defend believers „in battle against the wickedness and snares of the devil“ and to be their safeguard. The prayer calls Michael the „prince of the heavenly host“ and begs him, by the divine power and strength, to „thrust into hell“ Satan and other evil spirits, „who roam through the world for the ruin of souls“.

The tone then changes. From combative images, the prayer moves to a tender **prayer for unity with Jesus**. The intercessor turns to „lovely Jesus“ and prays that the life of believers may be completely harmonized with his. The images follow one after another:

- may our feet walk together,
- may our hands be gathered in unity,
- may our hearts beat together,
- may our souls be in harmony, and thoughts „as one“,
- may our ears together „listen to the silence“,
- may our glances „deeply penetrate one another“.

At the end comes a petition that the lips pray together so that „mercy may be obtained from the eternal Father“. With this, the theme of **mercy** directly appears for the first time, around which the entire prayer portion of the episode is built.

sections.subtitle: Dvostruka posveta: Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu i Presvetom Srcu Isusovu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara posvetu Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu
sections.content:
Sljedeći korak su dvije posvetne molitve. Prva je **posveta Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu**. U njoj se molitelj obraća Presvetoj Djevici Mariji kao „majci i kraljici“ i predaje joj „čitavo svoje biće, svoje misli, riječi i djela“. Daje joj pravo da raspolaže njime i svime što mu pripada, „sada i u vječnosti“. Svrha je posvete:

- hvala i slava Presvetoga Trojstva,
- posvećenje Crkve,
- spasenje svega svijeta.

Molitelj moli i pomoć da živi dostojno svoga **krsnog posvećenja** te da „neopozivo pripada svome Otkupitelju“. Želi, poput Marije, slušati poticaje Duha Svetoga, kako bi se u njemu i u svemu vršila volja Božja.

Druga je **posveta Presvetom Srcu Isusovu**. Ono se u molitvi naziva „izvorom svakoga dobra“. Molitelj mu se klanja, vjeruje u njega, uzda se u njega, ljubi ga i kaje se za sve svoje grijehe. Svoje „siromašno srce“ poklanja Isusu i moli da ga učini poniznim, strpljivim i čistim te da u svemu odgovara Isusovim željama. Molitva završava nizom konkretnih molbi:

- „da ja živim u tebi i ti u meni“,
- zaštita u opasnostima,
- utjeha u nevoljama i žalostima,
- zdravlje tijela,
- blagoslov svega rada,
- milost svete smrti.

Grebenar zatim najavljuje sljedeći dio: Krunicu Božjega milosrđa.
sections.subtitle_en: Double consecration: to the Immaculate Heart of Mary and the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host recites the consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
sections.content_en:
The next step is two prayers of consecration. The first is the **consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary**. In it, the intercessor addresses the Blessed Virgin Mary as „mother and queen“ and surrenders to her „his entire being, his thoughts, words, and deeds“. He gives her the right to dispose of him and everything that belongs to him, „now and in eternity“. The purpose of the consecration is:

- praise and glory of the Most Holy Trinity,
- sanctification of the Church,
- salvation of the whole world.

The intercessor also prays for help to live worthy of his **baptismal consecration** and to „belong irrevocably to his Redeemer“. He desires, like Mary, to listen to the promptings of the Holy Spirit, so that in him and in everything the will of God may be done.

The second is the **consecration to the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus**. It is called in the prayer the „source of every good“. The intercessor adores it, believes in it, hopes in it, loves it, and repents for all his sins. He offers his „poor heart“ to Jesus and prays that he make it humble, patient, and pure, and that in everything it correspond to Jesus' desires. The prayer concludes with a series of concrete petitions:

- „that I live in you and you in me“,
- protection in dangers,
- comfort in troubles and sorrows,
- health of the body,
- blessing of all work,
- the grace of a holy death.

Grebenar then announces the next part: the Chaplet of the Divine Mercy.

sections.subtitle: Krunica Božjega milosrđa: „Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli Krunicu Božjega milosrđa i izgovara molitvu „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv…“
sections.content:
Vladimir Grebenar uvodi **Krunicu Božjega milosrđa** kratkim pozivom: „Sklopimo oči, priđimo k milosrdnom Gospodinu.“ Molitva počinje temeljnim molitvama kršćanske tradicije: Očenašem, Zdravomarijom i Apostolskim vjerovanjem. Vjerovanjem molitelji ispovijedaju vjeru u Boga Oca, u Isusa Krista „mučena pod Poncijem Pilatom“ i uskrslog treći dan, u Duha Svetoga, svetu Crkvu katoličku, uskrsnuće tijela i život vječni.

Srce krunice čini pet desetica. Svaka počinje istom molitvom prikazanja:

> „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo preljubljenoga Sina tvojega, Gospodina našega Isusa Krista, kao zadovoljštinu za grijehe naše i cijeloga svijeta.“

Nakon nje dolazi deset ponavljanja zaziva **„Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci, budi milosrdan nama i cijelome svijetu.“** Grebenar ga izgovara ujednačenim, meditativnim ritmom. Ponavljanje stvara molitveno ozračje u kojem se pažnja usredotočuje na Kristovu muku kao izvor milosrđa.

Na kraju se tri puta moli zaziv: „Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože, sveti besmrtni Bože, smiluj se nama i cijelomu svijetu.“ Slijedi molitva krvi i vodi: „O krvi i vodo, što potekoste iz srca Isusova, kao izvor milosrđa za nas, uzdam se u tebe.“ Zaziva se i Marija kao **majka milosrđa**. Krunica završava trostrukim usklikom pouzdanja **„Isuse, uzdam se u tebe“** i molbom „Smiluj se nama i cijelomu svijetu, Gospodine.“
sections.subtitle_en: Chaplet of the Divine Mercy: „For the sake of His sorrowful Passion“
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host prays the Chaplet of the Divine Mercy and recites the prayer „Eternal Father, we offer you the Body and Blood…“
sections.content_en:
Vladimir Grebenar introduces the **Chaplet of the Divine Mercy** with a short invitation: „Let us close our eyes, let us approach the merciful Lord.“ The prayer begins with the foundational prayers of the Christian tradition: the Our Father, the Hail Mary, and the Apostles' Creed. Through the Creed, the intercessors profess faith in God the Father, in Jesus Christ „suffered under Pontius Pilate“ and risen on the third day, in the Holy Spirit, the holy Catholic Church, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting.

The heart of the chaplet consists of five decades. Each begins with the same offering prayer:

> „Eternal Father, we offer you the Body and Blood, Soul and Divinity of your dearly beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world.“

After it come ten repetitions of the invocation **„For the sake of His sorrowful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world.“** Grebenar recites it in a steady, meditative rhythm. The repetition creates a prayerful atmosphere in which attention is focused on Christ's Passion as the source of mercy.

At the end, the invocation is prayed three times: „Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal One, have mercy on us and on the whole world.“ The prayer of the blood and water follows: „O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fount of Mercy for us, I trust in You.“ Mary is also invoked as the **mother of mercy**. The chaplet ends with a threefold exclamation of trust **„Jesus, I trust in You“** and the plea „Have mercy on us and on the whole world, Lord.“

sections.subtitle: Litanije Božjem milosrđu: od stvaranja svijeta do duša u čistilištu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli Litanije Božjem milosrđu uz zaziv „uzdam se u tebe“
sections.content:
Uz Krunicu Božjega milosrđa voditelj moli i **Litanije Božjem milosrđu**. Počinju uobičajenim zazivima: „Gospodine, smiluj se. Kriste, smiluj se“, „Kriste, čuj nas. Kriste, usliši nas“. Zatim se zaziva svaka osoba Presvetoga Trojstva: Oče nebeski, Sine Otkupitelju svijeta i Duše Sveti.

Nakon toga slijedi dugi niz zaziva Božjem milosrđu. Svaki završava istim odgovorom: **„uzdam se u tebe“**. Litanije zapravo opisuju cijelu povijest spasenja kroz prizmu milosrđa. Milosrđe Božje u njima se naziva i opisuje kao:

- „neshvatljiva tajna Presvetoga Trojstva“ i „izraz njegove najveće moći“,
- milosrđe koje se objavilo u stvaranju nebeskih duhova i koje je ljude „iz ništavila pozvalo u život“,
- milosrđe koje obuhvaća čitav svijet i daruje besmrtan život,
- milosrđe koje štiti od zasluženih kazni i oslobađa od bijede grijeha,
- milosrđe koje se izlijeva iz rana Kristovih i izvire iz Presvetoga Srca,
- milosrđe koje je ljudima dalo Presvetu Djevicu za majku milosrđa,
- milosrđe vidljivo u ustanovljenju Crkve i u dijeljenju svetih sakramenata, osobito krštenja, pokore, oltara i svećeništva,
- milosrđe koje se očituje u obraćenju grešnika, posvećenju pravednika i usavršavanju svetih,
- vrelo za bolesnike i patnike, utjeha onih „koji su skršena srca“ i nada onih koji očajavaju,
- „mir umirućih“, zaštita od paklenoga ognja i olakšanje dušama u čistilištu,
- „slast i neizmjerna radost svih svetih“ te „neiscrpiv izvor čudesa“.

Ovi zazivi pokazuju da se Božje milosrđe prema ljudima ne shvaća kao jedan pojedinačni čin. U litanijama ono prati čovjeka od nastanka života, kroz sakramente i patnju, sve do smrti i vječnosti.
sections.subtitle_en: Litany of the Divine Mercy: from the creation of the world to the souls in purgatory
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host prays the Litany of the Divine Mercy with the invocation „I trust in You“
sections.content_en:
Alongside the Chaplet of the Divine Mercy, the host also prays the **Litany of the Divine Mercy**. It begins with the usual invocations: „Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy“, „Christ, hear us. Christ, graciously hear us“. Then each person of the Most Holy Trinity is invoked: Heavenly Father, Son Redeemer of the world, and Holy Spirit.

After that follows a long series of invocations to the Divine Mercy. Each ends with the same response: **„I trust in You“**. The litany in fact describes the entire history of salvation through the prism of mercy. God's mercy is named and described in them as:

- „incomprehensible mystery of the Most Holy Trinity“ and „expression of its greatest power“,
- mercy that manifested itself in the creation of heavenly spirits and that called human beings „from nothingness into life“,
- mercy that encompasses the whole world and bestows immortal life,
- mercy that shields from deserved punishments and frees from the misery of sin,
- mercy that flows out from the wounds of Christ and springs from the Most Sacred Heart,
- mercy that gave people the Blessed Virgin as the mother of mercy,
- mercy visible in the institution of the Church and in the dispensing of the holy sacraments, especially baptism, penance, the altar, and the priesthood,
- mercy manifested in the conversion of sinners, the sanctification of the righteous, and the perfection of saints,
- a spring for the sick and suffering, solace of those „who are brokenhearted“, and hope of those who despair,
- „peace of the dying“, protection from hellfire, and relief for souls in purgatory,
- „delight and immense joy of all saints“ and an „inexhaustible source of miracles“.

These invocations show that God's mercy toward people is not understood as a single individual act. In the litany, it accompanies man from the beginning of life, through the sacraments and suffering, all the way to death and eternity.

sections.subtitle: Završna molitva: ne očajavati u teškim trenucima
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara završnu molitvu za pouzdanje u Božje milosrđe
sections.content:
Litanije završavaju biblijskom ispoviješću: **„Bog je milosrdan i pun samilosti, spor na srđbu i pun dobrote.“** Na nju se nastavlja obećanje molitelja: „Zato ću dovijeka klicati milosrđu Božjemu.“

Vladimir Grebenar zatim moli završnu molitvu upućenu „vječnom Bogu“. Njegovo je milosrđe „neistraživo“, a „blago smilovanja neiscrpivo“. Molitva traži da Bog milostivo pogleda na molitelje i umnoži u njima svoje milosrđe. Svrha je jasno izrečena: **„da u teškim trenucima ne očajavamo i ne budemo obeshrabreni“**. Umjesto toga, vjernici se žele s velikim pouzdanjem predati Božjoj svetoj volji, „koja je sama ljubav i smilovanje“.

Molitva se zaključuje po Isusu Kristu, kojeg naziva **„kraljem milosrđa“**. Time završava dio posvećen Božjem milosrđu, temi istaknutoj već u naslovu epizode.
sections.subtitle_en: Concluding prayer: not despairing in difficult moments
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host recites the concluding prayer for trust in God's mercy
sections.content_en:
The litany ends with a biblical profession: **„God is merciful and full of compassion, slow to anger and abounding in goodness.“** Following upon it is the intercessor's promise: „Therefore I will forever proclaim God's mercy.“

Vladimir Grebenar then prays the concluding prayer addressed to the „eternal God“. His mercy is „incomprehensible“, and the „treasury of compassion inexhaustible“. The prayer asks that God look kindly upon the intercessors and multiply his mercy in them. The purpose is clearly stated: **„that in difficult moments we might not despair nor become despondent“**. Instead, believers wish to surrender themselves with great confidence to God's holy will, „which is love and mercy itself“.

The prayer is concluded through Jesus Christ, whom he calls the **„king of mercy“**. With this ends the portion dedicated to God's mercy, a theme highlighted already in the title of the episode.

sections.subtitle: Gospina krunica: slavna otajstva uskrsnuća, uzašašća i Duhova
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje Gospinu krunicu i prvo slavno otajstvo – Isusovo uskrsnuće
sections.content:
Nakon molitava milosrđu Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje **Gospinu krunicu** i poziva: „Priđimo Gospodinu i Gospi.“ Moli se **slavna otajstva**, koja razmatraju Kristovu pobjedu nad smrću i Marijinu proslavu.

Svaka desetica ima isti oblik:

- uvodni Očenaš,
- deset Zdravomarija,
- Slava Ocu,
- molitva „O moj Isuse, oprosti nam naše grijehe, očuvaj nas od paklenoga ognja, dovedi u raj sve duše, a osobito one kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe.“

I ova završna molitva svake desetice vraća se temi **milosrđa**, pa se Gospina krunica sadržajno povezuje s prethodnim dijelom.

Otajstva se nižu ovim redom:

1. **Prvo otajstvo** razmatra Isusovo **uskrsnuće** od mrtvih.
2. **Drugo otajstvo**, najavljeno na 00:20:53, posvećeno je Isusu „koji je na nebo uzašao“, odnosno **uzašašću**.
3. **Treća desetica**, s početkom na 00:24:46, razmatra Isusa „koji je Duha Svetoga poslao“, odnosno **silazak Duha Svetoga**.

Grebenar desetice moli mirno i ujednačeno, uz kratke stanke između otajstava. Gledatelji i slušatelji tako mogu moliti zajedno s njim.
sections.subtitle_en: Our Lady's Rosary: the glorious mysteries of the Resurrection, Ascension, and Pentecost
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host announces Our Lady's Rosary and the first glorious mystery – Jesus' Resurrection
sections.content_en:
After the prayers to mercy, Vladimir Grebenar announces **Our Lady's Rosary** and invites: „Let us approach the Lord and Our Lady.“ The **glorious mysteries** are prayed, which contemplate Christ's victory over death and Mary's glorification.

Each decade has the same form:

- introductory Our Father,
- ten Hail Marys,
- Glory Be to the Father,
- the prayer „O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell, lead all souls to Heaven, especially those most in need of Thy mercy.“

This concluding prayer of each decade also returns to the theme of **mercy**, so Our Lady's Rosary is substantively linked with the preceding part.

The mysteries follow in this order:

1. The **first mystery** contemplates Jesus' **resurrection** from the dead.
2. The **second mystery**, announced at 00:20:53, is dedicated to Jesus „who ascended into heaven“, that is, the **ascension**.
3. The **third decade**, beginning at 00:24:46, contemplates Jesus „who sent the Holy Spirit“, that is, the **descent of the Holy Spirit**.

Grebenar prays the decades calmly and steadily, with short pauses between the mysteries. Viewers and listeners can thus pray along with him.

sections.subtitle: Marijino uznesenje i krunjenje: vrhunac slavnih otajstava
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje peto slavno otajstvo – Marijino krunjenje na nebu
sections.content:
Završna dva slavna otajstva posvećena su Djevici Mariji.

**Četvrto otajstvo** Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje na 00:28:42 riječima koje se odnose na Isusa koji je Djevicu **„na nebo uznio“**. U središtu je razmatranja Marijino uznesenje na nebo. Desetica se moli istim redom kao i prethodne: Očenaš, deset Zdravomarija, Slava Ocu i molitva za oproštenje grijeha i spas duša, „osobito onih kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe“.

**Peto otajstvo**, najavljeno na 00:32:42, razmatra Isusa koji je Djevicu **„na nebu okrunio“**. To je Marijino krunjenje za kraljicu neba i zemlje, završna slika slavnih otajstava.

Ova dva otajstva posljednji put stavljaju Mariju u središte molitve. To je i logičan prijelaz prema završnoj marijanskoj molitvi, kojom se zaokružuje cijeli krunični dio emisije.
sections.subtitle_en: Mary's Assumption and Coronation: the culmination of the glorious mysteries
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host announces the fifth glorious mystery – Mary's Coronation in heaven
sections.content_en:
The final two glorious mysteries are dedicated to the Virgin Mary.

The **fourth mystery** is announced by Vladimir Grebenar at 00:28:42 with words referring to Jesus who **„assumed the Virgin into heaven“**. At the center of the contemplation is Mary's assumption into heaven. The decade is prayed in the same order as the previous ones: Our Father, ten Hail Marys, Glory Be to the Father, and the prayer for the forgiveness of sins and the salvation of souls, „especially those most in need of Thy mercy“.

The **fifth mystery**, announced at 00:32:42, contemplates Jesus who **„crowned the Virgin in heaven“**. That is Mary's coronation as queen of heaven and earth, the final image of the glorious mysteries.

These two mysteries place Mary at the center of prayer for the last time. It is also a logical transition toward the concluding Marian prayer, which rounds off the entire rosary portion of the episode.

sections.subtitle: „Zdravo Kraljice“: vapaj prognanih sinova Evinih
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli zaključnu molitvu „Zdravo Kraljice“
sections.content:
Molitveni dio epizode Vladimir Grebenar zaključuje drevnom marijanskom antifonom **„Zdravo Kraljice“**. Mariju u njoj pozdravlja kao **„majku milosrđa“** te kao „život, slast i ufanje naše“. Naziv „majka milosrđa“ još jednom povezuje kraj molitvenog bloka s njegovom glavnom temom.

Molitva opisuje ljudski život kao progonstvo. Vjernici su „prognani sinovi Evini“ koji k Mariji vape i uzdišu, „tugujući i plačući u ovoj suznoj dolini“. Mariju mole kao zagovornicu da na njih svrne „one svoje milostive oči“ i da im **„poslije ovoga progona“** pokaže Isusa, „blagoslovljeni plod utrobe svoje“.

Molitva završava trostrukim nježnim zazivom: **„o blaga, o mila, o slatka Djevice Marijo“**. Time se zatvara molitveni dio epizode. Slijedi tumačenje Božje riječi iz poslanice Efežanima, koje se nastavlja na najavljeno evanđelje o izboru dvanaestorice apostola.
sections.subtitle_en: „Hail Holy Queen“: the cry of the exiled children of Eve
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host prays the concluding prayer „Hail Holy Queen“
sections.content_en:
The prayer part of the episode is concluded by Vladimir Grebenar with the ancient Marian antiphon **„Hail Holy Queen“**. In it, he greets Mary as **„mother of mercy“** and as „our life, our sweetness, and our hope“. The title „mother of mercy“ once again connects the end of the prayer block with its main theme.

The prayer describes human life as an exile. Believers are „the exiled children of Eve“ who cry and sigh to Mary, „mourning and weeping in this valley of tears“. They pray to Mary as an advocate to turn toward them „her merciful eyes“ and that **„after this exile“** she show them Jesus, „the blessed fruit of her womb“.

The prayer ends with a threefold tender invocation: **„o clement, o loving, o sweet Virgin Mary“**. This closes the prayer portion of the episode. There follows the interpretation of the Word of God from the Epistle to the Ephesians, which continues onto the announced gospel about the choice of the twelve apostles.

iterations.theme_en: Prayer part: prayers of protection and consecration, Chaplet of the Divine Mercy, Litany of the Divine Mercy, and Our Lady's Rosary (glorious mysteries)

iterations.theme: Tumačenje Riječi: kako graditi Hram Božji – crkva protiv sotonine anticrkve, legitimitet kroz rezultate i djela za Gospodina, uz najave i obavijesti

sections.subtitle: Sugrađani svetih: crkva kao duhovni hram kojemu je Krist zaglavni kamen
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar započinje tumačenje čitanja iz Poslanice Efežanima
sections.content:
Nakon molitvenog dijela emisije, voditelj **Vladimir Grebenar** prelazi na tumačenje svete riječi. Polazište je odlomak iz Poslanice Efežanima: „Braćo, više niste tuđinci ni pridošlice, nego sugrađani ste svetih i ukućani Božji, nazidani na temelju apostola i proroka, a zaglavni je kamen sam Krist Isus.“ U Kristu je, kako stoji u čitanju, sva građevina povezana i raste u hram svet Gospodinu.

Grebenar objašnjava da sveti Pavao ovdje piše o gradnji crkve kao **duhovnog hrama**. U njega pristiže sve veći broj ljudi: pogani koji se obraćaju na kršćanstvo, ali i dio Židova, posebice onih u dijaspori. Ta građevina, naglašava voditelj, nije materijalna nego duhovna. Ona je ono što je u Starom zavjetu bilo predočeno slikom jeruzalemskog hrama, od kojega je do danas ostao samo Zid plača.

„Taj hram, to je čitava crkva, braćo i sestre, crkva Kristova“, sažima Grebenar.
sections.subtitle_en: Fellow citizens of the saints: the church as a spiritual temple whose cornerstone is Christ
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar begins the interpretation of the reading from the Epistle to the Ephesians
sections.content_en:
After the prayer portion of the show, host **Vladimir Grebenar** transitions to the interpretation of the holy word. The starting point is a passage from the Epistle to the Ephesians: „Brothers, you are no longer strangers and sojourners, but you are fellow citizens with the holy ones and members of the household of God, built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus himself as the capstone.“ In Christ, as the reading states, the whole structure is held together and grows into a temple sacred in the Lord.

Grebenar explains that Saint Paul writes here about building the church as a **spiritual temple**. An increasing number of people are arriving into it: gentiles who convert to Christianity, but also a portion of Jews, especially those in the diaspora. That structure, the host emphasizes, is not material but spiritual. It is what in the Old Testament was foreshadowed by the image of the Jerusalem temple, of which only the Western Wall remains today.

„That temple, that is the entire church, brothers and sisters, the church of Christ“, Grebenar summarizes.

sections.subtitle: Razjedinjena crkva: nacionalne pravoslavne crkve u službi politike
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj govori o razjedinjenosti crkve i autokefalnim pravoslavnim crkvama
sections.content:
Grebenar zatim postavlja kritično pitanje: što su ljudi učinili od crkve Kristove? U prvim kršćanskim vremenima ona je bila jedinstvena, a danas je razjedinjena. Kao primjer navodi istočnu, pravoslavnu crkvu, koja je i sama podijeljena po načelu **autokefalnosti**. Svaka je pravoslavna crkva, prema njegovu tumačenju, zapravo nacionalna i više u službi neke politike nego obraćanja ljudi.

Tu tvrdnju ilustrira dvjema pravoslavnim crkvama. Prva je ruska, za koju kaže da je u službi Putina. Druga je srpska, kao bliži primjer, za koju tvrdi da je bila u službi Vučića, pri čemu spominje i Porfirija. Uz ironično pitanje koga će sada „pokopati“, Grebenar cijelu situaciju opisuje jednom riječju: „Prestrašno.“
sections.subtitle_en: Divided church: national Orthodox churches in the service of politics
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host speaks about the division of the church and autocephalous Orthodox churches
sections.content_en:
Grebenar then poses a critical question: what have people made of the church of Christ? In early Christian times it was unified, and today it is divided. As an example, he cites the eastern, Orthodox Church, which is itself divided according to the principle of **autocephaly**. Every Orthodox church, according to his interpretation, is actually national and more in the service of some politics than of the conversion of people.

He illustrates that claim with two Orthodox churches. The first is the Russian, which he says is in the service of Putin. The second is the Serbian, as a closer example, which he claims was in the service of Vučić, in which connection he also mentions Porfirije. With an ironic question as to whom they will now „bury“, Grebenar describes the whole situation in one word: „Horrible.“

sections.subtitle: Kraj 40-dnevnog posta i pad „ratnog huškača“ s vlasti
sections.screenshot_description: Grebenar povezuje završetak posta protiv duhova rata s političkim promjenama u Srbiji
sections.content:
Grebenar ističe podudarnost koju smatra znakovitom. Upravo završava **40-dnevni post protiv rata i duhova rata**, a, kako kaže, „najveći ratni huškač na Balkanu je srušen s vlasti“. Riječ je o osobi koja je, prema njegovim riječima, neizravno prijetila oružjem, uključujući balističke rakete dometa 500 kilometara.

Voditelj prenosi podatak da je na izbore u Srbiji izašlo 70 posto birača. Tu brojku naziva izvanredno i nevjerojatno velikom te dodaje da nitko ne može objasniti što je toliki broj ljudi motiviralo. Tako su, kaže, srušili „diktatora, ratnog huškača“, čovjeka koji je prema njegovim riječima doprinosio ratu još u vrijeme Domovinskog rata u Hrvatskoj, bio sa „radikalom Šešeljem“, održao se na vlasti i širio ratnu mržnju, među ostalim i prema hrvatskom narodu.

Odmah zatim upućuje na Gospine riječi: **„Post može zaustaviti ratove.“** Ipak, Grebenar upozorava na oprez. Europu opisuje kao veliki duhovni vrtlog u kojemu ništa nije gotovo. Ovo je, kaže, tek prva i privremena pobjeda. Pritom se služi sportskom usporedbom: kao u dugom prvenstvu, jedna važna pobjeda još ne znači osvojen naslov. „Ima još mnogo utakmica, jako mnogo“, poručuje on.
sections.subtitle_en: End of 40-day fast and the fall of the „warmonger“ from power
sections.screenshot_description_en: Grebenar connects the completion of the fast against the spirits of war with political changes in Serbia
sections.content_en:
Grebenar highlights a coincidence that he considers significant. The **40-day fast against war and the spirits of war** is just concluding, and, as he says, „the biggest warmonger in the Balkans has been overthrown from power“. This refers to a person who, according to his words, indirectly threatened with weapons, including ballistic missiles with a range of 500 kilometers.

The host reports the data that 70 percent of voters turned out for the elections in Serbia. He calls that figure extraordinarily and unbelievably large and adds that no one can explain what motivated such a number of people. Thus, he says, they overthrew „a dictator, a warmonger“, a man who according to his words contributed to war back during the Homeland War in Croatia, was with the „radical Šešelj“, stayed in power, and spread wartime hatred, among other things toward the Croatian people.

Immediately after that, he points to Our Lady's words: **„Fasting can stop wars.“** Nevertheless, Grebenar warns of caution. He describes Europe as a great spiritual vortex in which nothing is finished. This, he says, is only the first and temporary victory. In doing so, he uses a sports comparison: as in a long championship, one important victory does not yet mean the title is won. „There are still many games, very many“, he conveys.

sections.subtitle: Gospina poruka na dan izbora: mržnja i rat vladaju u srcima ljudi
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj citira posljednju Gospinu poruku i poziva na jaču molitvu
sections.content:
Govoreći o tome kako se gradi crkva, Grebenar se poziva na posljednju Gospinu poruku i naziva je „vrlo znakovitom“. Podsjeća da zajednica Ora et Labora, koja potječe iz Međugorja, okuplja desetke tisuća ljudi u molitvi i tisuće u postu te upravo završava 40-dnevni post protiv duhova rata.

Poruka je, kako navodi, stigla prije dva-tri dana i poklopila se s danom izbora u Srbiji, 25. u mjesecu. U njoj Gospa poziva na **još jaču molitvu** i upozorava da mržnja i rat vladaju u srcima ljudi. „To je tako točno. To vidimo po Europi sada“, komentira Grebenar. Njegovo je tumačenje sljedeće: da bi se dogodio veliki rat, mora postojati mnogo ljudi koji rat nose u srcu. Kad se posti i moli, odstupaju „duhovi nacionalizma i rata“.

Zato ponavlja da nikakva pobjeda nije izvojevana i da su pred vjernicima duge bitke do konca. Poziva se pritom na Isusove riječi: „Tko ustraje do kraja, taj će se spasiti.“
sections.subtitle_en: Our Lady's message on election day: hatred and war reign in the hearts of men
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host quotes Our Lady's latest message and calls for stronger prayer
sections.content_en:
Speaking about how the church is built, Grebenar refers to Our Lady's latest message and calls it „very significant“. He recalls that the Ora et Labora community, which originates from Međugorje, gathers tens of thousands of people in prayer and thousands in fasting, and is just finishing a 40-day fast against the spirits of war.

The message, as he states, arrived two or three days ago and coincided with the day of the elections in Serbia, the 25th of the month. In it, Our Lady calls for **even stronger prayer** and warns that hatred and war reign in the hearts of people. „That is so accurate. We see that across Europe now“, comments Grebenar. His interpretation is as follows: in order for a great war to happen, there must be many people who carry war in their heart. When one fasts and prays, the „spirits of nationalism and war“ depart.

Therefore, he repeats that no victory has been won and that believers face long battles to the end. He cites in this regard the words of Jesus: „The one who perseveres to the end will be saved.“

sections.subtitle: Pet obraćenih duša vrijedi više od pet milijuna pregleda
sections.screenshot_description: Grebenar uspoređuje vrijednost obraćenih duša s brojem pregleda na podcastima
sections.content:
Borba između dobra i zla traje tisućama godina, a Grebenar ističe da i vjernici moraju dati svoj doprinos. Iznosi ključnu tezu ovog dijela tumačenja: **„Crkva se gradi tako da se ruše sotonine utvrde.“** Te se utvrde nalaze u srcima ljudi, a voditelj ih nabraja:

- mržnja,
- želja za ratom,
- želja za preljubom,
- želja za krađom,
- gramzivost i sebičnost.

Kad vjernici poste i mole za obraćenje drugih i za narod, te se utvrde ruše i sve više ljudi prilazi Kristu.

U nastavku Grebenar otvoreno kritizira kriterije medijskog uspjeha: „Više vrijedi pet obraćenih duša nego pet milijuna pregleda nečega na nekom podcastu.“ Pregleda može biti milijune, ali ako se ni jedna duša nije obratila i nitko nije rastao u vjeri, to prema njemu ništa ne vrijedi. Obraćenje pritom definira široko: kao rast u vjeri, otvaranje očiju i spoznaju nečega novoga.
sections.subtitle_en: Five converted souls are worth more than five million views
sections.screenshot_description_en: Grebenar compares the value of converted souls with the number of views on podcasts
sections.content_en:
The battle between good and evil has lasted for thousands of years, and Grebenar emphasizes that believers too must make their contribution. He puts forward the key thesis of this part of the interpretation: **„The church is built by tearing down Satan's strongholds.“** Those strongholds are located in the hearts of people, and the host lists them:

- hatred,
- desire for war,
- desire for adultery,
- desire for theft,
- greed and selfishness.

When believers fast and pray for the conversion of others and for the nation, those strongholds are torn down and more and more people approach Christ.

Continuing, Grebenar openly criticizes the criteria of media success: „Five converted souls are worth more than five million views of something on some podcast.“ There may be millions of views, but if not a single soul was converted and no one grew in faith, according to him that is worth nothing. In doing so, he defines conversion broadly: as growth in faith, the opening of eyes, and the realization of something new.

sections.subtitle: Prokazivati grijeh, a ne upirati prstom u osobu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj objašnjava razliku između osude grijeha i osude čovjeka
sections.content:
Jedino što ostaje za vječnost, poručuje Grebenar, jest **ljubav**. Ona se očituje u nesebičnom darivanju za drugoga, i to na razne načine: kroz molitvu, kroz post, ali i kroz društveni aktivizam, primjerice pisanjem tekstova na društvenim mrežama i prokazivanjem zla.

Pri tome postavlja jasnu granicu. Zlo treba prokazivati na primjeren način, a ne svađalački. Ne smije se upirati prstom u crkvu, fratre ili biskupe. „Može se uprijeti prstom u grijeh koji netko čini, ali baš uprijeti u osobu ili u instituciju, to se ne smije“, naglašava on. Istodobno upozorava da će vjernici odgovarati ako ne prokažu zlo i grijeh. Zato čovjeka uvijek treba odvojiti od grijeha.

Kao uzor navodi Isusa, koji je osudio grijeh, ali ni jednog čovjeka. Primjer je žena preljubnica: Isus je osudio grijeh, ali ne i nju. „Mi ne smijemo osuđivati druge ljude, nego osuditi grijeh“, zaključuje Grebenar.
sections.subtitle_en: Exposing sin, not pointing the finger at the person
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host explains the difference between condemning sin and condemning a person
sections.content_en:
The only thing that remains for eternity, Grebenar conveys, is **love**. It manifests itself in selfless giving for another, and that in various ways: through prayer, through fasting, but also through social activism, for example by writing texts on social networks and exposing evil.

In doing so, he establishes a clear boundary. Evil should be exposed in an appropriate manner, not in an argumentative way. One must not point a finger at the church, friars, or bishops. „One can point a finger at the sin that someone commits, but actually pointing at the person or at the institution, that is not allowed“, he emphasizes. At the same time, he warns that believers will be held accountable if they do not expose evil and sin. Therefore, man should always be separated from sin.

As a role model, he cites Jesus, who condemned sin, but not a single human being. An example is the adulterous woman: Jesus condemned the sin, but not her. „We must not condemn other people, but condemn the sin“, concludes Grebenar.

sections.subtitle: Javna isprika: voditelj priznaje vlastite slabosti
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar moli gledatelje za oprost zbog svojih pogrešaka
sections.content:
U jednom od najosobnijih trenutaka emisije Grebenar govori o kritikama na društvenim mrežama. One, kaže, mogu biti usmjerene protiv nekoga dobroga tko evangelizira, ili protiv njega samoga. „Ja nisam najbolji, ja to priznam“, kaže voditelj. Dodaje da moli Gospodina da ga obrati, učini još boljim i njegove slabosti pretvori u jakosti za Njega.

„Žao mi je zbog svih pogrešaka koje činim i koje sam napravio. Uistinu mi je žao“, govori Grebenar te se izravno obraća slušateljima: „Braćo, ja vas molim da mi oprostite.“

Iz tog priznanja izvodi pravilo. Gospodin želi da vjernici priznaju svoje slabosti i grijehe, i to javno ako je pogreška bila javna. Isto vrijedi i za prokazivanje tuđeg zla. Javno učinjeno zlo treba javno prokazati. Tajno zlo treba, kako kaže Isus, „šapnuti na uho“: najprije jednome, zatim dvojici, a onda dovesti svećenika. „Ako je nešto izašlo javno, onda se treba javno i pokajati, javno ispričati“, poručuje voditelj.
sections.subtitle_en: Public apology: host admits his own weaknesses
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar asks viewers for forgiveness because of his mistakes
sections.content_en:
In one of the most personal moments of the show, Grebenar speaks about criticism on social networks. That criticism, he says, can be directed against someone good who is evangelizing, or against himself. „I am not the best, I admit that“, says the host. He adds that he prays to the Lord to convert him, make him even better, and turn his weaknesses into strengths for Him.

„I am sorry for all the mistakes that I make and that I have made. I am truly sorry“, Grebenar says and addresses the listeners directly: „Brothers, I ask you to forgive me.“

From that admission he derives a rule. The Lord wants believers to admit their weaknesses and sins, and that publicly if the mistake was public. The same applies to exposing someone else's evil. Publicly committed evil should be exposed publicly. Secret evil should, as Jesus says, be „whispered in the ear“: first to one, then to two, and then bring a priest. „If something has come out publicly, then one should also repent publicly, apologize publicly“, conveys the host.

sections.subtitle: Strog prema grijehu, nježan prema grešniku
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj govori o grešnicima kao ranjenim ljudima kojima treba pomoć, a ne osuda
sections.content:
Kristova crkva, prema Grebenaru, širi se i naziđuje u ljubavi, praštanju i miru. Kad je potrebno, to se čini s nježnošću, a kad je potrebno, s hrabrošću. Formulu sažima ovako: **„Treba biti vrlo strog na grijeh, a vrlo nježan i blag prema grešniku.“**

Grešnici su, objašnjava on, ranjeni ljudi kojima treba pomoć, a ne osuda. Za učinak osude služi se slikovitom usporedbom: osuđeni čovjek osjeća se „kao mačka koja je stjerana u kut“ i mora se braniti. Bog nije osudio nikoga. Ljudi, prema njegovu tumačenju, osuđuju sami sebe svojim nedjelima i odbacivanjem Boga. „Bog nas nije odbacio. Bog je sebe odbacio na križu da bismo mi bili spašeni“, ističe Grebenar.

Zatim čita psalam iz dnevnih čitanja: „Nebesa slavu Božju kazuju, nebeski svod navješćuje djelo ruku njegovih. Dan danu to objavljuje, a noć noći glas predaje.“ Psalam završava slikom jeke koja se razliježe po svoj zemlji, sve do kraja svijeta.
sections.subtitle_en: Strict toward sin, gentle toward the sinner
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host speaks about sinners as wounded people who need help, not condemnation
sections.content_en:
Christ's church, according to Grebenar, spreads and is built up in love, forgiveness, and peace. When necessary, this is done with tenderness, and when necessary, with courage. He summarizes the formula like this: **„One must be very strict toward sin, and very gentle and mild toward the sinner.“**

Sinners are, he explains, wounded people who need help, not condemnation. For the effect of condemnation he uses a vivid comparison: a condemned man feels „like a cat backed into a corner“ and has to defend himself. God has not condemned anyone. People, according to his interpretation, condemn themselves by their misdeeds and rejection of God. „God did not reject us. God rejected himself on the cross so that we might be saved“, Grebenar emphasizes.

Then he reads a psalm from the daily readings: „The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands. Day unto day pours forth speech; night unto night reveals knowledge.“ The psalm ends with the image of an echo resounding through all the earth, unto the ends of the world.

sections.subtitle: Problem se ne rješava načinom koji ga je stvorio
sections.screenshot_description: Grebenar objašnjava poslovno pravilo i potrebu za duhovnom dimenzijom u rješavanju problema
sections.content:
Tko želi zidati crkvu i privoditi duše Kristu tako da im se mijenja život, mora drugačije govoriti, poručuje Grebenar. Tu se oslanja na pravilo iz poslovnog svijeta: način razmišljanja, ponašanja i djelovanja koji je doveo do problema ne može biti način koji će taj problem riješiti. Zato ljudi često ne uspijevaju riješiti probleme, primjerice u svojim brakovima i bračnim zajednicama.

Rješenje vidi u drugačijem pristupu. Treba moliti Boga za širi pogled i širu perspektivu, kako bi Duh Sveti uveo čovjeka u svu istinu. Tada Bog daje svoju riječ, a čovjek spoznaje da nije dovoljno stvari samo svjetovno tumačiti. Potrebna je i **duhovna dimenzija**, koju Grebenar smatra „puno važnijom“ jer dolazi od Duha Svetoga.

Usporedbu preuzima iz znanosti. Kad se otvori ta dimenzija, čovjek „ima još varijabli“, dodatne čimbenike i okolnosti, pa problem vidi na drugačiji način. Bog mu tada pokazuje kako se problem rješava i gdje je njegova vlastita odgovornost. „Svaka sotonina utvrda u životu pojedinca, obitelji i naroda je problem“, zaključuje voditelj. Poziv vjernicima stoga glasi: rješavati probleme, odnosno rušiti te utvrde.
sections.subtitle_en: A problem is not solved by the way that created it
sections.screenshot_description_en: Grebenar explains a business rule and the need for a spiritual dimension in problem-solving
sections.content_en:
Whoever wants to build the church and bring souls to Christ in such a way that their life changes must speak differently, Grebenar conveys. Here he relies on a rule from the business world: the way of thinking, behaving, and acting that led to a problem cannot be the way that will solve that problem. That is why people often fail to solve problems, for example in their marriages and marital unions.

He sees the solution in a different approach. One should pray to God for a wider view and a broader perspective, so that the Holy Spirit may lead man into all truth. Then God gives his word, and man realizes that it is not enough to interpret things only in a worldly manner. A **spiritual dimension** is also needed, which Grebenar considers „much more important“ because it comes from the Holy Spirit.

He borrows a comparison from science. When that dimension opens up, a person „has more variables“, additional factors and circumstances, and so sees the problem in a different way. God then shows him how the problem is solved and where his own responsibility lies. „Every stronghold of Satan in the life of an individual, a family, and a nation is a problem“, concludes the host. The call to believers is therefore: solve problems, that is, tear down those strongholds.

sections.subtitle: Đavlova računica: zašto sotona nastoji srušiti crkvu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj opisuje borbu crkve i đavlove anticrkve i đavlovu jedinu šansu za opstanak
sections.content:
Grebenar zatim opisuje dvije sukobljene strane. „Đavlu je problem crkva. On ne zna što bi s crkvom, on bi je uništio“, kaže on. Za katolike i kršćane, s druge strane, problem je **đavlova anticrkva**: grijeh i zlo. Vjernici su pozvani u ime Kristovo razarati sotonina grešna djela, dok je đavlova zadaća razarati crkvu. Na pitanje tko će pobijediti, voditelj odgovara: onaj koji ima jaču vjeru. Dodaje i Gospine riječi da slijedi konačna bitka između dobra i zla. Krist je đavla pobijedio, ali crkva, odnosno svi vjernici, to tek trebaju učiniti.

Voditelj potom slikovito rekonstruira „đavlovu računicu“. Đavao zna da ga je Krist pobijedio za sva vremena i da se u raj više ne može vratiti. Jedina mu je šansa da izbjegne ognjenu peć zauvijek da sruši crkvu na zemlji. Kad bi u tome uspio, prema Grebenaru bi Isusova žrtva na križu za čovječanstvo od tog trenutka postala bezvrijedna. Tko se do tada spasio, spasio se, ali bi nakon toga tama zavladala. Grebenar čak iznosi pretpostavku da bi đavao tim uspjehom računao na izazivanje pobune u raju.

Kao povijesni primjer navodi Hitlera. Prema njegovim riječima, Hitler je planirao potpuno iskorijeniti crkvu iz svijeta i uvesti arijevsku religiju, što Grebenar naziva Luciferovim nadahnućem. Iz toga izvlači pouku o nacionalizmu, koji je doveo do savezništva s onim koji je htio uništiti crkvu. Sve što se danas vidi u svijetu, vrtlozi, prosvjedi i „pakao rata“, prema voditelju je đavlovo nastojanje da uništi crkvu. „Ovaj trenutak u kojem živimo, mi odlučujemo na koju ćemo stranu“, poručuje on.
sections.subtitle_en: The devil's calculation: why Satan strives to overthrow the church
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host describes the struggle between the church and the devil's anti-church and the devil's only chance for survival
sections.content_en:
Grebenar then describes the two opposing sides. „To the devil, the church is a problem. He does not know what to do with the church, he would destroy it“, he says. For Catholics and Christians, on the other hand, the problem is **the devil's anti-church**: sin and evil. Believers are called in the name of Christ to destroy Satan's sinful works, while the devil's task is to destroy the church. To the question of who will win, the host replies: the one who has stronger faith. He also adds Our Lady's words that the final battle between good and evil is coming. Christ has conquered the devil, but the church, that is, all believers, still have to do so.

The host then vividly reconstructs the „devil's calculation“. The devil knows that Christ conquered him for all time and that he can no longer return to heaven. His only chance to avoid the fiery furnace forever is to overthrow the church on earth. If he were to succeed in that, according to Grebenar, Jesus' sacrifice on the cross for humanity from that moment would become worthless. Whoever was saved up to then was saved, but after that darkness would prevail. Grebenar even puts forward the assumption that the devil would count on that success to spark a rebellion in heaven.

As a historical example, he cites Hitler. According to his words, Hitler planned to completely eradicate the church from the world and introduce an Aryan religion, which Grebenar calls Lucifer's inspiration. From this he draws a lesson about nationalism, which led to an alliance with the one who wanted to destroy the church. Everything that is seen today in the world, vortexes, protests, and the „hell of war“, according to the host is the devil's endeavor to destroy the church. „This moment in which we live, we decide which side we will take“, he conveys.

sections.subtitle: Vjera i politika: nema mjesta za dva kraljevstva
sections.screenshot_description: Grebenar objašnjava zašto se vjerski podcast dotiče politike i zakona
sections.content:
„Ne dopusti da đavao ruši crkvu. Sprječavaj to“, poziva Grebenar. Ako mnogi koji bi trebali braniti crkvu to ne čine, moraju to činiti vjernici, jer „crkva smo svi mi“.

Objašnjava i zašto se u vjerskom podcastu, kako sam naglašava, ne političkom, dotiče aktualnih tema. Sveto pismo obiluje politikom i proroštvima protiv kraljeva. Isus kori Heroda i Poncija Pilata, a veliki svećenici Ana i Kajfa te narodne starješine, koje Grebenar naziva političkim liderima, dolaze iskušavati Isusa. „Božja riječ prožima sva područja života“, kaže on, pa tako i politiku. Bog je za politiku „jako zainteresiran“ jer se preko vlasti donose zakoni, primjerice o legalizaciji pobačaja i istospolnih brakova.

Takvim se zakonima, prema voditelju, ruši crkva koju sveti Pavao poziva zidati, a istodobno raste **„babilonska kula, sotonina anticrkva“**. Odnos je, kaže, isključiv. Crkva se ne može širiti ako se ne ruši anticrkva, a đavao ne može dizati svoju kulu ako prije toga ne ruši crkvu. „Nema mjesta ni za dva kraljevstva na zemlji. Ta dva kraljevstva su u ratu i nema ničijeg prostora“, ističe on. Na kraju poziva na osobno preispitivanje: možda neka područja života pripadaju Bogu, a neka grijehu i đavlu.
sections.subtitle_en: Faith and politics: no room for two kingdoms
sections.screenshot_description_en: Grebenar explains why a religious podcast touches upon politics and laws
sections.content_en:
„Do not allow the devil to tear down the church. Prevent it“, Grebenar calls out. If many who ought to defend the church do not do so, believers must do it, because „the church is all of us“.

He also explains why in a religious podcast, as he emphasizes himself, not a political one, he touches upon current topics. Sacred Scripture abounds in politics and prophecies against kings. Jesus rebukes Herod and Pontius Pilate, and the high priests Annas and Caiaphas and the elders of the people, whom Grebenar calls political leaders, come to test Jesus. „The Word of God permeates all areas of life“, he says, and thus also politics. God is „very interested“ in politics because through the authorities laws are passed, for example on the legalization of abortion and same-sex marriages.

Through such laws, according to the host, the church that Saint Paul calls to build is torn down, while at the same time **„the Tower of Babel, Satan's anti-church“** grows. The relationship, he says, is mutually exclusive. The church cannot spread if the anti-church is not torn down, and the devil cannot raise his tower if before that he does not tear down the church. „There is no room for two kingdoms on earth either. Those two kingdoms are at war and there is no neutral ground“, he emphasizes. At the end, he calls for personal self-examination: perhaps some areas of life belong to God, and some to sin and the devil.

sections.subtitle: Apostoli izabrani u molitvi: tko smije doći na mjesto u hijerarhiji
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj povezuje evanđelje o izboru dvanaestorice s Božjom potvrdom za služenje
sections.content:
Slijedi evanđelje dana. Isus se popeo na goru i proveo noć u molitvi. Kad se razdanilo, između učenika izabrao je dvanaestoricu i prozvao ih apostolima: Šimuna kojega prozva Petrom, Andriju, Jakova, Ivana, Filipa, Bartolomeja, Mateja, Tomu, Jakova Alfejeva, Šimuna zvanog Revnitelj, Judu Jakovljeva i Judu Iškariotskoga, koji posta izdajica. Mnoštvo iz Judeje, Jeruzalema te primorja Tira i Sidona dolazilo je da ga sluša i ozdravi, jer je iz njega izlazila snaga koja je sve ozdravljala.

Grebenar zatim objašnjava vezu između čitanja i evanđelja. Isus je proveo noć bez sna, što voditelj tumači kao oblik posta, i razgovarao s Bogom. U molitvi mu je Otac pokazao tko treba biti apostol. „Vidite kako se biraju apostoli, kako se biraju oni koji idu na hijerarhiju“, ističe on.

Iz toga izvodi pouku: nitko ne može doći na neku poziciju u hijerarhiji i služiti Bogu ako ga Bog prije toga nije potvrdio. Upozorava koliko je opasno kad se mnogi sami guraju. Zato savjetuje da onaj kome se ponudi takvo mjesto odgovori: „Moram prvo pitati Gospodina je li volja Božja.“ Ako jest, mora prihvatiti. Ako nije, Grebenar poručuje „bježi, čovječe, od toga“, jer se time čovjek ogrješuje i zbog vlastite nesposobnosti može druge odvesti u propast.
sections.subtitle_en: Apostles chosen in prayer: who may assume a place in the hierarchy
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host connects the gospel of the choice of the twelve with God's confirmation for ministry
sections.content_en:
The gospel of the day follows. Jesus went up to the mountain and spent the night in prayer. When day broke, he called his disciples to himself and chose twelve of them, whom he also named apostles: Simon, whom he named Peter, and Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon who was called a Zealot, and Judas the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor. A great crowd from Judea, Jerusalem, and the coastal region of Tyre and Sidon came to hear him and to be healed, for power came forth from him and healed them all.

Grebenar then explains the connection between the reading and the gospel. Jesus spent the night without sleep, which the host interprets as a form of fasting, and spoke with God. In prayer the Father showed him who should be an apostle. „You see how apostles are chosen, how those who enter the hierarchy are chosen“, he emphasizes.

From this he draws a lesson: no one can come into a position in the hierarchy and serve God if God has not first confirmed him. He warns how dangerous it is when many push themselves forward. Therefore, he advises that whoever is offered such a place should reply: „I must first ask the Lord whether it is God's will.“ If it is, he must accept. If it is not, Grebenar says „flee, man, from that“, because by doing so a person transgresses and through his own incompetence can lead others to ruin.

sections.subtitle: Gdje su ti rezultati? Legitimitet se zarađuje plodovima
sections.screenshot_description: Grebenar govori o legitimitetu koji daju rezultati, uz primjer iz vlastitog poslovnog savjetovanja
sections.content:
Grebenar se čudi gramzivosti mnogih političara za vlašću. Postavlja im pitanja: gdje su im kvalifikacije, gdje im je legitimitet i gdje su rezultati u njihovu životu koji bi ih ovlastili da predstavljaju narod i vladaju? Kao suprotnost navodi Isusa, koji je istjerivao zle duhove, liječio i obraćao ljude, pa se „more ljudi obratilo“. I Isus i apostoli imali su rezultate. „Kad imaš rezultate, oni ti daju legitimitet“, naglašava voditelj.

Kao primjer uzima vlastito iskustvo. Grebenar navodi da se bavi poduzetništvom i poslovnim savjetovanjem. Za njega bi bila sramota završiti poslovnu godinu s minusom, jer tada ne bi mogao drugima davati savjete. Pojašnjava da rad s minusom sam po sebi nije sramota i da se može dogoditi, ali da to nije blagoslov, nego znak nekog duhovnog problema. „Bog uvijek daje plus, nikad minus“, kaže on.

Isto pravilo primjenjuje na vjeru. Tko u životu nije nikoga obratio ni priveo Kristu, bio laik ili klerik, nema legitimitet govoriti o Bogu. Takav bi trebao moliti, postiti i raditi na sebi, a govoriti onoliko koliko ima rezultata. Upozorava i na Isusove riječi „Pazite kako slušate“. Slušanje osobe bez rezultata za kraljevstvo Božje može dovesti do zastranjenja, jer đavao ima mnoge koji su iznutra nadahnuti farizejštinom, licemjerjem i zavišću.

Kritiku Grebenar usmjerava i prema sebi. Pita se razara li on sam crkvu iznutra, stagniraju li ljudi zbog njega u vjeri i je li njegov govor „bljutav, kao kad sol obljutavi“, toliko da ljudi kažu: „Ne mogu ovo slušati.“
sections.subtitle_en: Where are those results? Legitimacy is earned through fruits
sections.screenshot_description_en: Grebenar speaks about legitimacy given by results, with an example from his own business consulting
sections.content_en:
Grebenar wonders at the greed of many politicians for power. He poses questions to them: where are their qualifications, where is their legitimacy, and where are the results in their lives that would authorize them to represent the people and govern? As a contrast, he cites Jesus, who cast out evil spirits, healed and converted people, so that „a sea of people was converted“. Both Jesus and the apostles had results. „When you have results, they give you legitimacy“, emphasizes the host.

As an example, he takes his own experience. Grebenar states that he is engaged in entrepreneurship and business consulting. For him, it would be a shame to finish a business year in the negative, because then he could not give advice to others. He clarifies that operating at a loss is not in itself a shame and that it can happen, but that it is not a blessing, rather a sign of some spiritual problem. „God always gives a plus, never a minus“, he says.

He applies the same rule to faith. Whoever in life has not converted anyone or brought anyone to Christ, whether layperson or cleric, lacks the legitimacy to speak about God. Such a person ought to pray, fast, and work on himself, and speak only as much as he has results. He also warns of Jesus' words „Take care how you hear“. Listening to a person without results for the kingdom of God can lead to straying, because the devil has many who are inwardly inspired by Pharisaism, hypocrisy, and envy.

Grebenar directs criticism toward himself as well. He wonders whether he himself is destroying the church from within, whether people are stagnating in faith because of him, and whether his speech is „tasteless, like when salt loses its flavor“, so much so that people say: „I cannot listen to this.“

sections.subtitle: Strah od prazne stranice u knjizi života
sections.screenshot_description: Grebenar prepričava dirljivo svjedočanstvo žene s jedne od promocija
sections.content:
Vraćajući se evanđelju, Grebenar podsjeća da se mnoštvo koje je slušalo Isusa obraćalo, raslo u vjeri i ozdravljalo, uključujući one koje su mučili nečisti duhovi. Tako se crkva gradila u Isusovo vrijeme, a to je, kaže, i danas najvažnije. Zato svatko treba sebi postaviti pitanje koji su pokazatelji njegova rada za kraljevstvo Božje.

U tom kontekstu prepričava „predivno svjedočanstvo“ jedne žene s promocije. Ona se, kako je rekla, boji da će Gospodin pred njom otvoriti knjigu njezina života, upitati je što je učinila za Njega i da će stranica biti **prazna**. Bojala se da će ondje pisati samo da je primala: Tijelo Kristovo na misi, oproštenje grijeha, milosti i radost na duhovnim obnovama. Ništa njoj u korist, nijedno djelo za Boga.

Grebenar ističe koliko je zrelo bilo to što je rekla kroz suze. Prisutni su joj na kraju zapljeskali. Voditelj priznaje da je zastao i oduševio se kad je to čuo. Prema njegovoj ocjeni, njezin kratak govor imao je veći utjecaj od njegova vlastitog izlaganja, a ljudi na njegov govor nisu reagirali tako pozitivno kao na njezine riječi. „Nekad Bog progovori preko nas tako snažno i to obrati nekoga“, kaže on te blagoslivlja sve koji srcem žele služiti Gospodinu i imati djela za Boga.
sections.subtitle_en: Fear of an empty page in the book of life
sections.screenshot_description_en: Grebenar recounts the moving testimony of a woman from one of the book promotions
sections.content_en:
Returning to the gospel, Grebenar recalls that the crowd listening to Jesus was converting, growing in faith, and being healed, including those tormented by unclean spirits. That is how the church was built in Jesus' time, and that, he says, is still the most important thing today. Therefore, everyone should ask themselves what the indicators of their work for the kingdom of God are.

In that context, he recounts the „wonderful testimony“ of a woman from a book promotion. She, as she said, fears that the Lord will open the book of her life before her, ask her what she did for Him, and that the page will be **empty**. She feared that there would only be written that she received: the Body of Christ at Mass, forgiveness of sins, graces, and joy at spiritual retreats. Nothing to her credit, not a single deed for God.

Grebenar emphasizes how mature it was what she said through tears. Those present applauded her at the end. The host admits that he paused and was thrilled when he heard that. In his assessment, her short speech had a greater impact than his own presentation, and people did not react as positively to his speech as to her words. „Sometimes God speaks through us so powerfully and that converts someone“, he says, blessing all who desire with their heart to serve the Lord and have deeds for God.

sections.subtitle: Trajni nalog „za Gospodina“ i svjedočanstvo ozdravljenja
sections.screenshot_description: Grebenar zahvaljuje donatorima i čita svjedočanstvo o ozdravljenju
sections.content:
Grebenar poziva slušatelje da postanu članovi domoljubne inicijative Ora et Labora. Prijava se ispunjava putem forme na web stranici. Za one koji imaju poteškoća s internetom prikazani su brojevi mobitela, uključujući i one za Bosnu i Hercegovinu, na koje se mogu javiti za pomoć.

Zahvaljuje donatorima i prenosi anegdotu s promocije. Jedna mu je žena rekla da je otvorila trajni nalog, a on joj je odgovorio da ga je otvorila **„za Gospodina, ne za nas, najmanje za mene“**. Sredstva se, objašnjava, usmjeravaju u ono što je važno za hrvatski narod. Namijenjena su „ostatku koji ima vjeru“ i onima koji žele biti dio crkve o kojoj piše sveti Pavao, koji se žele obratiti i rasti u vjeri. Poziva na daljnju podršku „široke ruke i otvorena srca“.

Zatim čita kratko svjedočanstvo jedne slušateljice ili slušatelja: „Hvala i slava Isusu. Ozdravio me od velikih bolova u mjehuru. Strašni problemi. Doktori nisu ništa mogli pomoći. Gospodin me ozdravio. Opet mogu bez straha podignuti svoju djecu.“ Svjedočanstvo završava molitvom da Isusa slavi i ljubi cijela Hrvatska.
sections.subtitle_en: Standing order „for the Lord“ and a testimony of healing
sections.screenshot_description_en: Grebenar thanks donors and reads a testimony of healing
sections.content_en:
Grebenar invites listeners to become members of the patriotic initiative Ora et Labora. Registration is filled out via a form on the website. For those who have difficulties with the internet, mobile phone numbers are displayed, including those for Bosnia and Herzegovina, which they can contact for help.

He thanks donors and conveys an anecdote from a promotion. A woman told him that she set up a standing order, and he answered her that she set it up **„for the Lord, not for us, least of all for me“**. The funds, he explains, are directed toward what is important for the Croatian people. They are intended for the „remnant that has faith“ and those who want to be part of the church Saint Paul writes about, who want to convert and grow in faith. He calls for continued support with an „open hand and an open heart“.

Then he reads a short testimony from a female or male listener: „Praise and glory to Jesus. He healed me of severe pain in the bladder. Terrible problems. Doctors could not help at all. The Lord healed me. I can again lift my children without fear.“ The testimony ends with a prayer that all of Croatia praise and love Jesus.

sections.subtitle: Krunica na trgu i molitvene skupine: „Vas dvoje-troje, ali gdje jeste“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj poziva na molitvu krunice u Zagrebu i najavlja centar Kraljica Mira
sections.content:
Pred kraj emisije Grebenar poziva na molitvu krunice na trgu u **Zagrebu**. Poziv je upućen i Hrvatima u Njemačkoj i Austriji, za koje se organizira prijevoz, a brojevi mobitela prikazani su na ekranu.

Istodobno potiče slušatelje da molitvu pokrenu u vlastitom mjestu, putem WhatsApp grupe, pa makar ih bilo samo dvoje ili troje. Podsjeća na prethodni dan, kada je tumačio prispodobu o gorušičinu zrnu: gdje su dvojica ili trojica u Isusovo ime, ondje je i Bog i to će narasti. „Dat će Bog da naraste, pa će to biti nešto veliko u hrvatskom narodu, veliko za svijet. Već sad jest“, poručuje on.

Emisiju zaključuje blagoslovom: „Neka se sveta Mati sa svojim Sinom i svetim Josipom udostoji blagoslov svoj nam dati.“ Na kraju podsjeća da se kupnjom njegove prve, druge i treće knjige pomaže završetak, kako kaže, privatnog projekta za Gospodina. Riječ je o **Međunarodnom edukacijskom centru Kraljica Mira**, koji opisuje kao mjesto za evangelizaciju i nastavak gradnje crkve. Oproštaj s gledateljima glasi: „Neka je sve na veću slavu Božju.“
sections.subtitle_en: Rosary in the square and prayer groups: „Two or three of you, but right where you are“
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host invites to the rosary prayer in Zagreb and announces Queen of Peace center
sections.content_en:
Toward the end of the show, Grebenar invites to the rosary prayer in the square in **Zagreb**. The invitation is also extended to Croats in Germany and Austria, for whom transportation is organized, and mobile phone numbers are displayed on the screen.

At the same time, he encourages listeners to launch prayer in their own locality, via a WhatsApp group, even if there are only two or three of them. He recalls the previous day, when he interpreted the parable of the mustard seed: where two or three are in Jesus' name, there God is also and that will grow. „God will grant that it grows, and it will be something great in the Croatian nation, great for the world. It already is right now“, he conveys.

He concludes the show with a blessing: „May the holy Mother with her Son and Saint Joseph deign to grant us their blessing.“ At the end, he reminds that buying his first, second, and third books helps complete, as he says, a private project for the Lord. It concerns the **Queen of Peace International Educational Center**, which he describes as a place for evangelization and the continued building of the church. The farewell to viewers is: „May all be to the greater glory of God.“

iterations.theme_en: Interpretation of the Word: how to build the Temple of God – the church against Satan's anti-church, legitimacy through results and deeds for the Lord, with announcements and notices
